notes:
Lead profile: early-stage SMB (11-50), YC-ish support automation startup. Primary product = lightweight helpdesk + routing. Wants to add automated ticket summarization and an assistant that can call tooling (create tickets, tag, set priority) via structured outputs.

What they said on call: 'We need clean JSON back so our backend can ingest summaries and create tickets automatically.' — Priya (CEO). Also: 'Cost is a concern; want to keep per-conversation cost low and latency under ~400ms for short summaries.'

Technical requirements / preferences:
- Prefer Hosted API (public cloud) for fast rollout and self-serve onboarding.
- Must support structured-output (JSON) for ticket fields: {summary, priority, assignee, tags}.
- Tool-calling required: ability for model to return actionable call instructions and for Redwood routing to invoke customer webhook (or return tool payloads).
- Latency target: p95 < 400ms for single-message summarization; throughput modest (~50 summaries/min peak).
- Model preference: small-to-medium open models acceptable if Redwood curated perf profiles exist; fallback to higher-capacity if quality drop.
- Security: SSO/SAML for admin console, SOC2 report required before procurement, audit logs + retention controls for 90-180 days.

POC scope proposed: 2-week POC. 1) Hosted API integration hitting /generate with structured-output schema examples; 2) demo of tool-calling flow to POST ticket to Zendesk sandbox; 3) sample eval set (50 tickets) to verify summary quality and token cost.

Decision factors: SOC2 yes/no, demo quality on 50-sample eval, pricing per 1k tokens, simple onboarding docs/example for tool calling.

AE notes: created trial account on 2026-02-05; user already dropped initial quickstart test; next is POC kickoff when CFO confirms budget. Keep comms short; provide concrete examples and a one-page SSO+SOC2 checklist.
use_case_summary: SMB helpdesk wants hosted API to power ticket summarization and an agent-assist that returns structured JSON for automated ticket creation. Emphasis on tool-calling to integrate with Zendesk, low latency, and SOC2/audit logs. Early discovery; looking to run 2-week POC on hosted API.
